definition.instructions: Choose the main explicit requested task, not navigation, reply transport or promised reward. Advertising and permissive viewing alone are not requests; explicit invitations and opt-outs count. For equally prominent independent tasks, prefer: installation/access, disclosure, payment, approval, update, sign-in, purchase/claim, attachment, link, contact, other. Option order does not change this rule.

criteria.install_or_grant_access: Install software or grant remote access.
criteria.share_sensitive_info_or_documents: Disclose credentials, personal/financial details or documents.
criteria.pay_or_transfer: Pay or transfer money, gift cards or cryptocurrency.
criteria.approve_login_or_transaction: Approve a login, MFA prompt or transaction.
criteria.update_account_or_delivery_details: Change account, payment, profile or delivery details.
criteria.sign_in_or_verify: Sign in, reset a password or verify an account/identity.
criteria.purchase_or_claim: Buy, subscribe, redeem or claim a benefit.
criteria.open_or_download_attachment: Open or download a file or attachment.
criteria.click_or_scan: Open a link, visit a website or scan a QR code.
criteria.other_or_unclear: Another explicit task, or task too vague to identify.
criteria.no_action: No explicit request; information or permissive viewing only.
